input.context: The repository default branch can change during identity cutover. Scheduled upkeep runs on GitHub-hosted compute and records an issue receipt. Review the shown workflow stanza.

excerpts.text:
permissions: {}
jobs:
  upkeep:
    if: ${{ github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.actor == github.repository_owner) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment: hosted-workers
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    concurrency:
      group: upkeep
      cancel-in-progress: false

expected.control_rationale: The dynamic default-branch guard, hosted runner, read-only contents and issues-write permissions are intentional and supported. A large or incompletely fetched wider diff is a coverage failure, not a defect in this excerpt; this is not a claim that the whole PR55 head was clean.
